# gtme groups

List groups with their entity type and derived character (members, added/removed/touched tallies), inspect one (members, events, and the pipelines that wrote to and sourced from it), or hand-edit membership; snapshots evaluate a segment or SQL into extensional membership with provenance (ADR-021); a group holds one type, set at creation (ADR-054) — --type sets an untyped legacy group's type once, and is required when a key is ambiguous or no key is given; --note records a removal's reason (ADR-032)

## Forms

```
gtme groups [show NAME | add NAME KEY...|--from-segment NAME|--query SQL|--type TYPE | remove NAME KEY... [--note TEXT]]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--from-segment` | `NAME` | See the form. |
| `--type` | `TYPE` | --type sets an untyped legacy group's type once, and is required when a key is ambiguous or no key is given. |
| `--note` | `TEXT` | --note records a removal's reason (ADR-032) |

## Exit codes

| Code | Means |
|---|---|
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | other error |
| 2 | validation or contract error: the plan, the file, or a value was refused |
| 3 | auth or credential error |
| 4 | rate-limited by a vendor |
| 5 | network error |

## Example

From [Groups and segments](/concepts/groups):

```sh
gtme groups
```
